name: @etzhayyim/toshi-kozan-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of toshi-kozan (都市鉱山 urban-mining public reference: recoverable-material catalog + depot directory + safety guidance + depot-acceptance edges) using @etzhayyim/sdk.
